contents_summary: Supplementary Table 1 (two parts): demographic, clinical and genetic features of 52 reported Chinese neonatal NOMID cases by study, with a legend. All 35 units read. The first part (studies 1 to 25) and the other columns of the second part are literature data; the last column of the second part, headed "Our case" (case 52), is the index infant and its cells are transcribed.
